_README: Wave plan for the X211-X229 statement-authoring waves (WP5 triage, 2026-09-23, Claude Opus 5 subagent, session 01P75Y6ikkgDyzUzzoef316Z). Triaged: the 38 Bondy-Murty / 'others' rows of WP1, the 136 arXiv rows that are endpoints of an implies/equivalent_to edge in meta/corpus_relations.json and have no statement, the 6 new arXiv rows (2309.04460__01..03, 2308.15387__02..04) and axv_2310_04265_03 (re-encoding). Each row is 'author' (a finite graph/digraph/hypergraph proposition statable with coq-graph-theory + GTBase + MathComp) or 'blocked' (a graph statement whose faithful encoding needs an out-of-scope layer -- a computation model, probability, real geometry -- kept in the wave as a placeholder definition plus blocked_reason, per the X124/X210 convention, only where a companion row of the same paper is authored in the same phase, so the corpus edge stays complete). Rows that are neither are listed under 'deferred': they keep legs.statement = todo and carry a defer_reason in meta/v2_classification.json. 'needed_vocabulary' lists the notions a row needs that are absent from coq-graph-theory and from base/theories (base.v, common.v, surface.v, posets.v, asymptotics.v, graph_metric.v, complexity.v); a notion needed by >= 2 packages belongs in base/theories/common.v, one needed by >= 2 waves of one package in that package's foundations/, otherwise it stays local (WP4b rule 3). 'related_edges' are the implies/equivalent_to edge ids of meta/corpus_relations.json whose BOTH endpoints already own a Rocq statement or are planned in this file, i.e. the implications_X2nn.v candidates the wave unlocks. Wave keys follow meta/v2_statement_waves.json: X2nn, or X2nn:<repo> when one phase spans several packages. X222 and X224 are unused: after triage the digraph-theory and extremal-graph-theory rows each fit in a single wave. This file is a plan, not state: meta/v2_statement_waves.json stays the authority once a wave is implemented.
